source_basis.note: Endpoint states, minimum effort fields, and the requirement for matched field effort come from the existing prospective contract. Binary-denominator handling, PERSON_MINUTES_V1, and no-skip frozen-order assignment are frozen before prospective outcomes are opened.

newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.success_numerator: count of SEARCH_COMPLETED_DETECTED_VERIFIED among analysis units admitted by the pre-outcome allocation schedule
newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.identity_unresolved_handling: report separately; exclude from the resolved binary denominator until identity is resolved by the predeclared verification process; never recode as absence
newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.non_biological_negative_handling: report separately; exclude from the biological detection/non-detection denominator; never recode as absence
newly_frozen_primary_binary_endpoint.primary_between_arm_contrast: difference in verified-current-occurrence success proportion between the frozen primary method and each frozen comparator, evaluated only under the pre-outcome matched-effort allocation schedule

effort_accounting.reason_pending: The candidate-specific visit allocation and numerical person-minute schedule cannot be instantiated until the still-missing private range-sector geometry produces exact frozen candidate identities.
effort_accounting.forbidden_inference: Do not change the person-minute metric, choose a new effort threshold, visit count, stopping rule, or favorable subset after field outcomes are opened.

schedule_selection_mechanics.rule: For each cohort unit and method arm, the unique scheduled candidate references must be a no-skip prefix of the exact hash-verified frozen arm order. Repeat visits may repeat a candidate already inside that prefix.

analysis_unit_and_repeated_visits.required_next_gate: Freeze the analysis unit, repeated-visit aggregation rule, shared-candidate handling, and candidate-specific visit/allocation schedule before opening prospective outcomes.

promotion_claim_ceiling.allowed_after_all_pre_outcome_gates_and_: test whether the frozen structural-within-coverage order improves verified current-occurrence recovery relative to frozen comparators at matched person-minute field effort
not_authorized_by_this_contract: discoveries per hour as a validated product claim

pre_outcome_gate_state.next_gate: After private candidate/order freeze and immutable public hash pin, instantiate a no-skip frozen-order schedule with matched PERSON_MINUTES_V1 effort, then publicly pin its receipt before any outcome-opening workflow.
